statementTypes.definition: A deterministic fact emitted by an authorized calculation/projection runtime; no interpretation is implied.
A fact explicitly reported by the user and preserved with source provenance.
A meaning record admitted from CMR under the W9 production-admission gate.
A governed interpretation result from the existing interpretation authority; never raw-model invention.
A separately attributable human professional judgment from PR.
A bounded possible direction or observation option that does not choose for the user.
An explicit unresolved, unavailable, not-included, or insufficiently supported state.
